Update Elo ratings after a match

Source: R/elo_update.R
elo_update.Rd

Updates both players' ratings after a single match. The winner gains rating points and the loser drops the same amount, scaled by the K-factor and by how surprising the result was. Inputs follow the winner/loser layout of the ATP match data.

Usage

elo_update(winner_rating, loser_rating, k = 32, scale = 400)

Arguments

winner_rating

Numeric. Rating(s) of the match winner before the match.

loser_rating

Numeric. Rating(s) of the match loser before the match.

k

Numeric. K-factor, the maximum number of points a single match can move a rating. Defaults to 32.

scale

Numeric. Rating gap that produces 10-to-1 odds. Defaults to 400, the standard chess value.

Value

A list with elements winner and loser holding the updated ratings.

Examples

# Two equal players: the winner gains 16 points
elo_update(1500, 1500)
#> $winner
#> [1] 1516
#> 
#> $loser
#> [1] 1484
#> 

# An upset moves more points than an expected result
elo_update(1400, 1600)
#> $winner
#> [1] 1424.312
#> 
#> $loser
#> [1] 1575.688
#> 

# A smaller K-factor makes ratings move more slowly
elo_update(1400, 1600, k = 16)
#> $winner
#> [1] 1412.156
#> 
#> $loser
#> [1] 1587.844
#>
